# relay_access_grant (Resource)

Gives a user or a team access to one connection or connection group of a workspace. A grant cannot be changed in place: changing any argument replaces it. A grant that has expired, or was revoked outside Terraform, is removed from state on the next refresh, so the next apply recreates it; an `expires_at` that is already in the past is rejected by the platform at that point. Recreating also clears the expired grant the platform still holds for the same grantee and target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_access_grant" "payments" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  grantee_type = "team"
  grantee      = "payments"
  target_type  = "connection"
  target       = relay_connection.payments_app.name
}

resource "relay_access_grant" "oncall" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  grantee_type = "user"
  grantee      = "alex@example.com"
  target_type  = "connection_group"
  target       = "production-readonly"
  expires_at   = "2026-12-01T18:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grantee` (String) Email of the organization member when `grantee_type` is `user`, name of the team when it is `team`.
- `grantee_type` (String) Kind of principal receiving access: `user` or `team`.
- `target` (String) Name of the connection or connection group, in the workspace. Renaming it replaces the grant.
- `target_type` (String) Kind of resource the grant opens: `connection` or `connection_group`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the grant belongs to.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the grant stops taking effect, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and whole seconds, in the future. Omit for a permanent grant. Not available on every plan.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `granted_by` (String) Principal that created the grant.
- `id` (String) Grant ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_access_grant.payments <workspace_id>/<grant_id>
```
